terms.comment: Classically a coin (Hor. Ep. 2.1.234), and in the Digest an old coin out of circulation, a medal. A gold medal is nomisma aureum, silver argenteum, bronze aereum (Traupman; Morgan–Owens has aēneum).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 344, checked against the searchable text of the book on 11 November 2026.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. prize: medal.
